title: fix: Settings search has no focus outline in forced colors
body: ## What Problem This Solves Settings search has no visible keyboard-focus outline when forced-colors mode suppresses its shadow-based focus ring. Tabbing into the input leaves keyboard users without the distinct focus indicator shown on surrounding Settings controls. ## User Impact Keyboard users can identify the focused Settings search input in high-contrast mode. Normal light and dark themes retain their existing focus shadows, and searching, clearing the query, and moving focus continue to work as before. ## Why This Change Was Made The search input explicitly removes the normal outline and uses a box shadow for focus. A forced-colors media rule now gives its `:focus-visible` state a 2px `Highlight` outline, using the browser's system color. The rule stays with the input's existing stylesheet; the search component and its keyboard handlers are unchanged. ## Evidence On base `87aada17522b9146cf5e26df3352b81d8cc0669b`, the bundled Chromium regression reaches the real Settings input with keyboard focus and `:focus-visible`, but both the outline style and shadow are `none`. The regression fails there. On head `0e05b45c194f0144191974201bf16e5f18f0e200`, it passes with a solid 2px system-color outline. The capture scenario also verifies searching, Escape-to-clear, moving focus away and back, and settled normal light/dark themes. The unfocused before/after frames are byte-identical, and no configuration mutations occur. A separate WebKit 27.2 check passes the same keyboard-focus and unfocused-outline conditions. WebKit's media emulation retains normal page colors and shadows, so Chromium provides the forced-palette and shadow-suppression evidence shown below. Both use the production UI bundle with synthetic Gateway data; these checks do not claim physical OS high-contrast or assistive-technology certification. Changed-file formatting, lint/style checks and the affected E2E type graph pass. The [full UI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39929148816) passes all three UI unit rows, nine mocked-browser rows and two real-Gateway rows; the original regression passed in 1,260 ms. Declared live opt-in cases remain skipped. The broader run retains baseline failures in unrelated tooling, session diagnostics, Windows fixture cleanup, native/update checks and dead-code checks; it is not a green whole-suite result. The Windows installer recovery passed on the same head, and the target branch includes the independent exec-completion test correction in #181563. The [earlier selected run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39890553360) also covers the stylesheet's direct test consumers and 36 Settings-sidebar/search cases. ## Visual evidence []() | View | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Keyboard focused | ![Keyboard focused Settings search before the forced\-colors fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e8b47f5b-e008-49b2-8c8c-a525fcbc0628) | ![Keyboard focused Settings search after the forced\-colors fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e2a0045-cdff-4b97-9778-b91d245e39a3) | | Unfocused control | ![Unfocused control Settings search before the forced\-colors fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad7353fb-c2b7-43c0-bc39-d2e0256e43c4) | ![Unfocused control Settings search after the forced\-colors fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad7353fb-c2b7-43c0-bc39-d2e0256e43c4) | ### Keyboard focus and preserved search behavior https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bed62ae1-5387-4406-812f-975ee12bf347 ### Visual verification - Baseline: 87aada17522b9146cf5e26df3352b81d8cc0669b - Exact head: `0e05b45c194f0144191974201bf16e5f18f0e200` - Scenario: Use Shift\+Tab and Tab to move keyboard focus away from and back to Settings search; search Typography, clear it, and verify normal light/dark controls\. - Runtime/build: Source tree c2975836ba60af899e6bba7d04c0513ea00b950c; Chromium production UI bundle; after ui\-D\-uuJ\-jR\.css; before ui\-CLIwJTik\.css; synthetic Gateway - Forced\-colors focused outline: Before: none\. After: solid 2px Highlight with 2px offset\. - Unfocused control: No outline before or after\. - Normal light/dark controls: Existing focus shadows retained; no outline\. - Search and mutation controls: Search and Escape clear pass; no config\.set or config\.patch requests\. - Keyboard focus and focus\-visible confirmed on the real Settings input - Original regression fails on base and passes on exact candidate - Normal light/dark themes explicitly settled before measuring - Synthetic Gateway data; no live account or provider calls Accessibility audit requested by Mitchell Etzel (@etzelm).
